note: Breeding at the ranch (roadmap item 57, first part; core/game/game_breeding.gd). A creature set to breed pairs each year with a grown, rested, fertile creature of the opposite sex that it is compatible with: the same species (breeds true: pure), a species of its own family (a cross-breed: it carries both lines, is likelier to be sterile and less fertile), or a pair the game has a recipe for (a hybrid, in breeding.json; none yet). Each year a pair rolls for young on its own seeded dice (dynasty seed, year, the two creatures), never the dynasty's. Young keep the mother's species and line; they inherit traits from either parent and can mutate a new one.
